symptom: report all: traceability proves 5 of 111 requirements where report traceability proves 101, readiness can never pass 'not assessed in full' (no way to give test results), and performance shows one 'step' per functional journey, each over budget
cause: passThrough forwarded --journeys/--spans to performance and tests only, report all had no --junit/--run/--tests, and one journey log fed both the functional reports and performance
insight: A roll-up is only as right as the inputs it hands on: test it per receiving report (TestReportAllHandsEachReportItsOwnInputs), not only that every page is written. A functional log and a performance run are different evidence and get different flags; --run runs once and leaves junit.xml for the next report to read
